dice.title: Glitch Roll
dice.subtitle: // dice.exe — corrupted
dice.desc: Roll under or over a target. Outcome computed on-chain from blockhash + your seed.
dice.placeholder: Game logic not wired yet. Connect wallet and wait for the next agent pass.
dice.rulesIntro: Pick a target number (2–98), choose roll under or roll over, set your bet, then hit Roll dice under the cube.
dice.rulesStep1: Roll under — you win if the result is strictly below your target.
dice.rulesStep2: Roll over — you win if the result is strictly above your target.
dice.rulesStep3: Win chance equals the percentage of outcomes in your favour (before house edge).
dice.rulesStep4: FUN mode uses the same FNV-1a RNG math as on-chain play — virtual credits only.
dice.rulesRng: // live: outcome = hash(blockhash ‖ seed ‖ nonce ‖ "dice") mod 100 + 1 — verifiable on Explorer

slot.payoutHint: Pair ×2 · triple ×10 (before house edge). Symbols: 7 X # ? ! 0
slot.rulesIntro: Set your bet and pull the lever under the bandit panel. Three corrupted reels stop on glitch symbols.
slot.rulesStep1: All three symbols match — triple payout (×10 gross).
slot.rulesStep2: Any two symbols match — pair payout (×2 gross).
slot.rulesStep3: No match — you lose the bet.
slot.rulesStep4: FUN mode uses the same FNV-1a RNG as on-chain — virtual credits only.
slot.rulesRng: // live: each reel = hash(blockhash ‖ seed ‖ nonce ‖ "slot"+index) mod 6

fair.title: Provably fair
fair.intro: Every roll is derived from public inputs by FNV-1a hashing. Recompute it yourself — if it matches, the casino did not cheat.
fair.formula: hash = FNV-1a( blockhash[0..32] · seed(LE) · nonce(LE) · domain )
fair.funNote: Fun mode uses a simulated blockhash with the SAME math as on-chain. Switch to LIVE for a real Solana tx you can open in the explorer.
fair.liveNote: Open the transaction in Solana Explorer and recompute the hash yourself.
fair.noPlay: Play a round first, then verify it here.
